source: Native screenshot of the installed 0.3.62 Settings page, captured during installation verification on 20 October 2026.
crop: Appearance and Git crops contain only built-in Preview fixtures, presets and Icon controls. The groups crop contains the table switcher, column header and Add group row only. Window title, navigation, real project names, paths and saved group rows are excluded.
demoData: Frontend, Backend, Tools, example editor text, branches and line counts are built-in demo fixtures. The generic user-preset name is Git with icons.
processing: Three rectangular crops of the same native capture, lossless PNG encoding; UI labels and pixels were not redrawn or retouched.
settings: Custom appearance; capture did not change saved appearance. Temporary group verification settings were subsequently restored.
